title: COME AND GO WITH ME

lines.text: Come and go with me to my Father's House,
To my Father's House, to my Father's House.
Come and go with me to my Father's House,

chords:
[Verse]
[F]Come and go with [Bb]me to my [F]Father's [C]House,
To my [F]Father's [C]House, to my [F]Father's House.
Come and go with me to my Father's House,
Where there's [F]peace, [C]peace, [F]peace.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Come and go with me to my Father's House,
To my Father's House, to my Father's House.
Come and go with me to my Father's House,
Where there's peace, peace, peace.
